sessions.intent: Design an OBP animation library (PLang app + JS runtime) distilled from aniva/rafbokin/coder animations, then a beginner PLang lesson built with it

before.assumptions: Three bots built near-identical canvas animation engines; the reusable core can be one OBP library. PLang builds/assembles; only the browser player/draw engine is JS.
before.risk: OpenRouter account has no credits (TTS/music blocked); committing on the architect branch app-systems may collide

actions.context: OBP JS engine: root film.this, context film.frame, lesson data sealed; ported best-of aniva/rafbokin/coder with origin comments; offline-baked soundtrack (music+cues+voice+ducking) played from offset; code blocks as real DOM text; smoke test in chromium: no errors, voice intelligible over music (verified by transcription), peak -0.5 dBFS
12+4 Gemini 3.8 TTS samples; found instructions field + lowercase plang needed; Ingi chose Achird on flash-lite

after.status: Lessons 1 and 2 done; lesson 2 exported to mp4 (export/mp4.js); Writer shots pending Ingi

sessions.intent: Teach OBP (the Object-Based Pattern) as a language-agnostic pattern in two lessons: A the laws and rules, B the named smells

before.assumptions: The docs (object_pattern_formal.md, obp-smells.md) are the source of the pattern; every code excerpt in the lesson is quoted verbatim from plang C# or the film engine JS with path:line
before.risk: Doc examples are partly illustrative and the docs list known drift in the codebase; a lesson could present drift as the pattern, or doc pseudo-code as real code

actions.context: Lesson 3 (OBP, any language) text: 12 scenes, every excerpt verbatim with path:line (C# PLang/app, JS film engine), checked by grep -F; %!app.type% proven by a built and run goal. Six doc/code disagreements tabled for Ingi.

Course web UI (Ingi asked): plang Hub writes /shared/educator/index.html from each lesson's timeline.json, written by the export from the film engine itself; mp4 player, chapters with sources, transcript following the video, resume. Checked in Playwright at 1280 and 400 px with a WebM copy (Playwright Chromium has no H.264).
Lesson 1 exported to mp4 (291 s, --disable-gpu, 3 browsers).

Lesson 3 reworked on Ingi's review: C# only and problem-first, then the C# moved to an advanced lesson; lesson 3 is the laws lightly, the root in plang (built and run), the rules, the new dot-case rule with a real .pr (app-systems merged, aa5eb3084), and a recorded exception from obp-scan.md.

Lesson 3 animated: 13 chapters, 40 voice takes (35 exact by transcription; 5 confirmed by targeted questions), 39 shots with no errors, mp4 231.4 s, on the course page. New engine piece film.paper.label (a card sized to its words) to stop repeating piece+fillText per card.

after.status: Lessons 1-3 voiced, checked, exported to mp4 and on the course page; advanced OBP-in-C# lesson written (not animated)
after.notes: Next: lesson 4 (smells). Open: doc/code table to docs bot; FINDINGS 28-31.
